subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks for the call this morning — great to meet you all. Quick recap and the proposed plan for the POC so we can get your team unblocked and running by the end of next week.

Success criteria (what we'll validate during the 2-week PoC):
- Latency: P95 < 300ms for 1k token prompts in your region
- Throughput: sustain 25 qps for bursty inference traffic
- Quality: Redwood responses meet a 4/5 median rating on your evaluation prompts
- Integration: ability to call the API from your dev environment with SSO + IP allowlist

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Acme: provide evaluation prompt set + pass/fail thresholds (owner: Alex)
- Redwood: provide PoC environment, API keys, observability dashboard, and support (owner: Marissa / Dev)

Access & provisioning items we discussed:
1) SSO invites (SAML) — we can send an IdP link once we have your SP metadata or email list for invites
2) IP allowlist — please confirm public IP ranges we should whitelist; we'll provide the service IPs from our side for egress
3) API key — short-lived PoC key; we typically rotate after 2 weeks

Attachments: poc-playbook.pdf (PoC checklist + runbook) attached for reference.

Next steps:
- Alex / Security to confirm SP metadata or a point of contact (Priya?) for SSO.
- Alex to send IP ranges to whitelist.
- We'll provision a PoC API key and send SSO invite by Thu 11/12.
- Schedule a 30m check-in for end of first week (propose Mon 11/16).

If the timeline looks good, I will loop in Dev to provision credentials and Stephanie to own onboarding.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa — that all looks good to us. A few clarifications from the security team (looping in Priya):

- SP metadata: Priya, can you share the Acme SP metadata XML or confirm who manages SAML at Acme?
- IP ranges: we can provide a short list — currently our egress ranges are 35.198.0.0/16 and 34.120.0.0/16 (prod), but for this PoC we can open a narrower set if needed.
- Data handling: we need a short statement on where logs are stored and retention (SOC2 evidence is fine).

For success criteria: Alex confirms we'll provide the prompt set by EOD Friday (11/13).

Tom: I'm happy to be the technical lead for integration — I'll own the first-week test harness.

On scheduling: Mon 11/16 10am PT works for our team for the check-in.

On the PoC timeline, can you confirm the PoC API key will be scoped to a test project and have usage limits?

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

On Tue, 10 Nov 2026 at 09:15, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Great, thanks Alex and Priya — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few updates and answers inline: 

- SP metadata: Priya, if you can drop the metadata XML or a metadata URL we'll configure the SP immediately. If you prefer, we can send SSO invite links for individual emails.
- IP allowlist: narrower ranges are fine for PoC — please send the smallest CIDR blocks you can. We will provide the Redwood egress IPs and the list will be attached to the PoC ticket.
- Logs/retention: attaching a short SOC2 excerpt in the PoC playbook; for the record, logs for the hosted PoC environment are retained for 30 days by default (we can extend with an enterprise add-on).
- API key scope: yes — PoC keys are scoped to a test tenant/project and have a default rate limit (50 qps) and quota; we can tighten these on request.

I've created a PoC ticket and looped in Dev to provision: Dev, can you create a short-lived API key scoped to project acme-poc-test, add the PoC IP allowlist once Alex confirms, and upload the key to the secure attachment below? Also please send the SSO SP endpoint URL to Alex once configured.

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 11/12: Dev provisions API key + SSO config + send credentials (target EOD)
- Mon 11/16: First-week check-in (integration status + initial prompts)
- Fri 11/27: End of PoC — validation against success criteria

Attachments: poc-playbook.pdf (again).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks — I provisioned the PoC resources this afternoon. Summary of what I set up: 

- API key: redwood-poc-acme-20261112 (short-lived, expires 2026-11-26). I uploaded a secure stub as an attachment (redwood-poc-api-key.txt). Please treat this as the PoC credential and don't paste it in public places.
- IP allowlist: we will accept the two CIDRs you listed for initial testing (35.198.0.0/16, 34.120.0.0/16). If you want tighter ranges, send them and we'll update.
- SSO: I configured the SP using the metadata provided and triggered IdP invites to the emails on the thread (Alex, Tom, Priya). The SAML SP endpoint is https://poc.redwood.ai/saml/sp/consume/acme — let me know if you need the full metadata (attached: sso-metadata.xml).

Attachments: redwood-poc-api-key.txt (API key stub), sso-metadata.xml

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm you can authenticate via SSO and call the API with the key.
- Marissa/Stephanie: I'll hand off monitoring links to the console once Alex confirms.

If any access problems, ping me directly and I can join a screenshare.

Regards,
Dev
Senior Engineer, Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
